Wood junction and gypsum corners (drawings on printed pages 23–24)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 23
W1 through / W2 butt: wood junction — W1 frame x = 0 → 156¾; y = −4 → −½ · W2 frame x = 149½ → 156¾; y =
−½ → C · W2 finishes: x = 149 pantry / x = 157⅜ room · C = 52⅝ candidate column front; no frame through
retained column.
printed page 23
W1-S11 backer: x = 148–149½. W1-S12 end stud: x = 155¼–156¾.
W2-S01: x = 149½–156¾ and y = −½–1; its full-width receiver is not established.
printed page 23
INSIDE CORNER: W2-P (½) butts to W1-P face. Folded tape + compatible compound only if accepted as a
fixed joint.
OUTSIDE CORNER: W1-R (½) laps W2-R (⅝). Approved bead + compound; profile field-fit.
printed page 23
½ + 7¼ core + ⅝ = 8⅜ in
printed page 23
Connection type, fasteners, access, added blocking and load path require acceptance. This page shows fit
and support geometry only. It is not an assembly fastening detail.
